unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese, Book 2, Lesson 1, pp. 2–14
unit.label: Reading a map
unit.title: Walk with a Map
unit.description: Learn to use a map, describe continuing actions, and talk about shops and alleys.

goal.text: 他們看著地圖，經過兩個巷子。
goal.pinyin: Tāmen kànzhe dìtú, jīngguò liǎng ge xiàngzi.
goal.meaning: They keep looking at the map and pass two alleys.

lessons.title: Get the map
lessons.subtitle: Download a map onto the phone.

steps.prompt: What does 下載 mean here?
steps.explanation: 下載 (xiàzài) means download: save digital information from a network to your device. 載 is pronounced zài in this word. Use 下載 before the thing being downloaded; 下載了 adds completed-action 了.

steps.prompt: What does 地圖 mean here?
steps.explanation: 地圖 (dìtú) means map. 下載地圖 (xiàzài dìtú) means “download a map.” 一張地圖 (yì zhāng dìtú) means “one map”; 張 is the measure word you already use for flat items.

steps.prompt: 下載地圖 means to do what?
steps.explanation: In this context, Download a map.

lessons.title: Is it useful?
lessons.subtitle: Evaluate whether a map works well.

steps.prompt: What does 好用 mean here?
steps.explanation: 好用 (hǎoyòng) means easy to use or handy. 這張地圖很好用。 (Zhè zhāng dìtú hěn hǎoyòng.) means “This map is easy to use.” Ask 地圖好用不好用？ (Dìtú hǎoyòng bù hǎoyòng?) to ask whether it is easy to use.

steps.prompt: Interpret the full message: 我下載了一張地圖。
options: I have not downloaded a map.
steps.explanation: 下載 is download; 了 after the verb marks the completed action. 一張地圖 is one map, using the familiar measure word 張. Put what was downloaded after 下載了.

steps.prompt: 地圖好用。 What is being evaluated?
options: The map is too far away.
steps.explanation: In this context, The map is handy.

lessons.title: Keep looking
lessons.subtitle: Use 著 for a continuing action or state.

steps.prompt: What does 著 mean here?
steps.explanation: 著 (zhe, neutral tone) follows a verb to show a continuing action or state. 看著地圖 (kànzhe dìtú) means “looking at the map,” with the looking continuing. It does not say that the looking has finished.

steps.prompt: 他看著地圖。 — what does the whole sentence mean?
options: He keeps looking at the map.
He has finished looking at the map.
He will buy a map tomorrow.
steps.answer: He keeps looking at the map.
steps.explanation: 著 (zhe, neutral tone) follows the verb and presents an action or state as continuing: 看著 means looking, 拿著 (názhe) means holding. In 他看著地圖往前走, looking at the map continues while he walks. 沒 negates the continuing situation; 不是 does not replace it. In a question, 是不是 can come before the whole verb phrase. 著 is not a marker that an action has finished.

steps.prompt: What does 他看著地圖往前走。 mean?
options: He keeps looking at the map as he walks forward.
He finishes looking at the map before he walks.
He walks forward without looking at the map.
steps.answer: He keeps looking at the map as he walks forward.
steps.explanation: 看著地圖 describes the continuing background action: looking at the map. 往前走 is the movement happening with it: walking forward. 著 stays immediately after 看, before 地圖.

steps.prompt: 看著地圖。 Is the looking presented as continuing or finished?
steps.explanation: In this context, Continuing.

steps.prompt: 他沒拿著地圖。 Which scene fits?
options: He is not holding the map.
steps.answer: He is not holding the map.
steps.explanation: 拿著 describes holding; 沒 negates that ongoing situation.

steps.prompt: 他是不是拿著地圖？ What are you checking?
options: Whether he is holding the map.
Whether he finished downloading a map.
Whether he sold a map yesterday.
steps.answer: Whether he is holding the map.
steps.explanation: 是不是 asks about the continuing state described by 拿著.

lessons.title: Goods on the street
lessons.subtitle: Recognize and describe shops selling daily necessities.

steps.prompt: What does 日用品 mean here?
steps.explanation: 日用品 (rìyòngpǐn) are articles used in daily life: daily necessities. 這家店賣日用品。 (Zhè jiā diàn mài rìyòngpǐn.) means “This shop sells daily necessities.” 日用 describes everyday use and 品 means articles or goods.

steps.prompt: What does 這家店賣日用品。 mean?
steps.explanation: 這家店 means this shop, using 家 to count shops. 賣 is sell; 日用品 names what the shop sells.

steps.prompt: Which shop category means daily necessities?
steps.explanation: In this context, 日用品

lessons.title: Past the alleys
lessons.subtitle: Pass a small lane on foot.

steps.prompt: What does 巷子 mean here?
steps.explanation: 巷子 (xiàngzi) means alley or narrow lane. 這個巷子裡有一家店。 (Zhège xiàngzi lǐ yǒu yì jiā diàn.) means “There is a shop in this alley.” 裡 places the shop inside the alley.

steps.prompt: What does 經過 mean here?
steps.explanation: 經過 (jīngguò) means pass by or go past. 經過兩個巷子 (jīngguò liǎng ge xiàngzi) means “pass two alleys.” In directions, this tells you to pass those landmarks, without telling you to turn into either alley.

steps.prompt: What does 我們經過兩個巷子。 mean?
options: We turned into the second alley.
We stopped before the first alley.
steps.explanation: 我們 is the subject. 經過 means pass by; 兩個巷子 are the two alleys passed. This sentence does not tell you to enter the second alley. Chinese verbs do not change form to mark tense; the translation assumes a trip being retold.

steps.prompt: 經過兩個巷子。 What happened?
steps.explanation: In this context, We passed two alleys.

lessons.title: Notice a place
lessons.subtitle: Describe finding a store on the map.

steps.prompt: What does 發現 mean here?
steps.explanation: 發現 (fāxiàn) means discover or notice something you had not noticed before. 我發現一家店。 (Wǒ fāxiàn yì jiā diàn.) means “I discover a shop.” Put what you discover after 發現.

steps.prompt: What does 我發現巷子裡有一家店。 mean?
options: I discover a shop in the alley.
I discover a shop inside the school.
I discover that there is no shop in the alley.
steps.answer: I discover a shop in the alley.
steps.explanation: 發現 introduces what you notice. 巷子裡有一家店 means there is a shop in the alley. Combine them to say what you discovered.

steps.prompt: 發現一家店 means what?
steps.explanation: In this context, Notice a shop.

steps.prompt: 我們經過兩個巷子，發現一家賣日用品的店。 What do we discover?
steps.explanation: 發現 introduces the discovery; 賣日用品的店 identifies the shop. All information is in the sentence.
